_note: Page facts for `cc threads` (read-only list of claude.ai/code threads). Data, not code: fix UI drift here. Probed live on the HELM host 2026-10-17: the sidebar lists threads as <div data-row><a href=/code/session_<id>> rows; a row's title is its visible text, and two screen-reader spans carry the status (Running, Unread response, Awaiting input; absent when none) and the environment (Cloud). Recents loads 20 rows, then a 'Show N more in Recents' button (20, 20, 10 seen) until it disappears. That button is below the fold inside the sidebar scroller, so it is reached with a DOM click. Regex strings are case-insensitive. There is deliberately NO 'auth' block here: sign-in cookies are the claude platform's (claude.json).
